judgments.description: Current opening: 'Get Skyvern running and automate your first browser task in under five minutes.' This sentence states the time promise but omits the WHY — it doesn't tell a developer what Skyvern actually does or why automating a browser task with it is valuable. A reader who lands here cold has no context. Suggested stronger opening: 'Skyvern uses AI to control a real browser on your behalf — this guide walks you through installing it and running your first automated browser task in under five minutes.'
